name: ntr_db_es_payout_breakdown
xsql:
SELECT 
    -- Organ Health Percentages (Prospera vs. Renasight)
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') AND sub_category = 'Prospera' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Oh_prospera_pct,
               
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') AND sub_category = 'Renasight' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Oh_renasight_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') AND sub_category = 'Others' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('OH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Oh_others_pct,

    -- Oncology Percentages (Initial vs. Follow-On)
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') AND sub_category = 'Initial Patients' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Onc_initial_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') AND sub_category = 'Follow On Patients' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Onc_followon_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') AND sub_category = 'Others' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('ONC') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Onc_Others_pct,

    -- Women's Health Percentages (Volume vs. Points)
    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') AND sub_category = 'Volume Retention' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Wh_vol_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') AND sub_category = 'Points Goal' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Wh_pts_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') AND sub_category = 'Others' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
          CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 
               ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN category IN ('WH') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) END, 0), 0) AS Wh_Others_pct

FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.amount,
        m.category,
        /* Falls back to Territory Mapping if Master Mapping sub_category is NULL or blank */
        CASE 
            WHEN m.sub_category IS NULL THEN tm.sub_category
            ELSE m.sub_category
        END AS sub_category
    FROM xactly.xc_payment p
    
    -- 1. Embedded Title Mapping
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pta.title_name AS title_name
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
            ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
            ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
            ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    
    -- 2. Embedded Territory Mapping (LEFT JOIN to prevent dropping ONC data)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pa_active.territory AS territory
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
            ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
            ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

    INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
        ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
       AND pta.title_name = m.title
       
    LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
        ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
        
    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
      AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
) raw_data;
